name: What type of drywall is best for a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What type of drywall is best for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathrooms, moisture-resistant drywall, often called 'green board' or mold-resistant drywall, is recommended. It has a special paperless or fiberglass mat face and a moisture-resistant core to prevent mold and mildew growth in high-humidity environments. Regular drywall can quickly degrade and develop mold in bathrooms, so it's best avoided.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moisture-resistant drywall, also known as 'green board' or mold-resistant drywall, is best for bathrooms to prevent mold and mildew.
